review.assessment: The change directly addresses the calculation defect in `cohort/stats.median` by replacing the faulty index-based selection with parity-aware averaging for even-length lists, while preserving correct behavior for odd lengths and empty inputs. The implementation uses integer arithmetic `(lower + upper + 1) // 2` to correctly round .5 cases upward (half-up), matching the provided north-cohort example (median of 3000, 4200, 4400, 5000 → 4300). It does not touch `data/orders.json` or report formatting, fully adhering to constraints.
